 V/s

others
 Through:- Mr. Amit Gupta, Aag.

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Wasim Sadiq Nargal, Judge
 Order

01. This Court, vide order dated 05.11.2022, had directed respondent Nos. 1 and 4 to file a detailed affidavit within two weeks, and respondent Nos. 1 and 4, i.e., Collector Land Acquisition System and Operations Wing, Power Development Department, and Chief Engineer, M&RE Wing, Jammu, were directed to remain present in the Court on the date fixed.

entities.text: Collector Land Acquisition System and Operations Wing, Power Development Department
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: 02. When the case was taken up on 30.11.2022, the respondent No. 4- Mr. Sandeep Seth, Chief Engineer, M&RE Wing, Jammu was present in the Court and he assured the Court that the order/judgment dated 26.06.2013 passed by this Court in OWP No. 736/2013 will be complied with in its letter and spirit, positively within one month and the compensation as directed by this Court in terms of the said order/judgment which has assumed finality, will also be paid to the petitioner.

03. In the light of the assurance extended by the Chief Engineer, M&RE Wing, Jammu, who was present in the Court, the proceedings in the aforesaid contempt petition were deferred for the time being, his personal presence was also dispensed with, and the matter was directed to be listed on 02.02.2023.

04 . However, in spite of the assurance extended by the concerned Chief Engineer, M&RE Wing,
Jammu, on 30.11.2022, the compliance report was not filed and, accordingly, this Court vide order dated 08.02.2023, was constrained to direct respondent No. 4 (present incumbent holding the Radha Kesar vs Surinder Mohan Sharma And on 18 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82638238/
1 post), to appear in person on the date fixed to explain his conduct before proceeding further in the matter and the Registry was directed to serve the order to the Office of Chief Engineer, M&RE Wing,
Jammu.
05.

entities.text: Radha Kesar vs Surinder Mohan Sharma
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Today, when the case is taken up, Mr. Sandeep Seth, Chief Engineer, M&RE Wing, Jammu, is present in Court and has assured the court that whatever steps were required to be taken have already been taken by him, and now it is left to the Collector Land Acquisition, 220 KV, PDD,
JKPTCL, Jammu, who has to release the payment in favour of the petitioner.
06.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondents has referred to Paras 7 and 8 of the latest statement of facts filed on behalf of respondent Nos. 2 and 3 which are reproduced as under:
"7.

That the post of the Collector PDD (JPDCL) was vacant and the Government vide Order 29-K (GAD) of 2023 dated 10.01.2023 has given additional charge of the post of the Collector Land Acquisition 22O KV Power Development Department to Mr. Dharam Pal JKAS, Deputy Director Libraries, Jammu and accordingly meeting was held with the Collector Land Acquisition in the office of answering respondent and fresh intend was placed for post-facto acquisition of land and vide communication No. CEJ/TS-II/Indent/6958-83 dated 25.01.2023 and also submitted the original papers of the land.
8. That the Collector Land Acquisition PDD has taken up the matter with the Deputy Commissioner Jammu vide communication no. CLA/PDD/220KV/182-85 and requested to exempt of the process of undertaking of Social impact Assessment Study for acquisition of land measuring 02 KI -0.5 Ml for Receiving Station 33/11 KV Situated in Village Chak Dina, Tehsll Marh, District Jammu which is to be acquired on urgent basis, as there is provision under section 9 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act-2013, which provides that in case of land invoking the urgency, so that the land acquisition process be initiated and compensation be given to the rightful claimants."

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act-2013,
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
07. From the perusal of the aforesaid stand taken by the respondents, it is apparently clear that Mr.
Sandeep Seth, Chief Engineer, M&RE Wing, Jammu, has already taken all the possible efforts to release the compensation in favour of the petitioner but the Collector Land Acquisition, 220 KV,
PDD, JKPTCL, Jammu, till date has not released the payment in favour of the petitioner.
08.

In view of the aforesaid, it would be apt to direct Mr. Dharam Pal, Collector Land Acquisition,
220 KV, PDD, JKPTCL, Jammu, to appear in person to explain his conduct as to why till date the compensation has not been released in favour of the petitioner and why the contempt proceedings be not initiated against him.

09. Let an affidavit be filed on behalf of Collector Land Acquisition, 220 KV, PDD, JKPTCL, Jammu within a period of two weeks from today.
10.

In the meantime, let a fresh compliance report be filed by respondent Nos. 1, 2 and 4 within a period of two weeks in compliance with the order/judgment dated 26.06.2013 passed by this Court Radha Kesar vs Surinder Mohan Sharma And on 18 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82638238/
2 in OWP No. 736 of 2013 in its letter and spirit, and the compensation as directed by this Court be also released during the aforesaid period.

entities.text: Radha Kesar vs Surinder Mohan Sharma
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 11. However, it is made clear that in case the order/judgment dated 26.06.2013 is not complied with within the aforesaid period, respondent Nos. 1 and 4 shall remain present in the Court on the next date of hearing.
Meanwhile, personal appearance of respondent No. 4- Mr. Sandeep Seth, Chief Engineer, M&RE Wing, Jammu, is dispensed with for the time being.

(Wasim Sadiq Nargal) Judge Jammu:
